In article <gGrqjNA2...@bgrace.demon.co.uk>,
Justin Grace <Jus...@bgrace.demon.co.uk> wrote:
>
> OK, can I use Horrid Reality (assuming at superior level) to bring out a
> Bomb/Grenade/White Phosphorous Grenade and use it there and then for a
> strike (burning the Bomb/whatever) and then shuffle the equipment back
> into my library at the end of the combat, just like the Horrid Reality
> text says?

No. Horrid Reality will only reshuffle the weapon into the library
if it (the weapon) is still in play at the end of the combat. It
will not retrieve the weapon from the ash heap.

> And what if I used Horrid Reality to pull an Assault Rifle out, then
> used Dragons Breath Rounds? Would the Assault Rifle be shuffled back in
> after the combat? Would the DBR be shuffled back in, since I'm only
> using an illusionary DBR in my illusionary Assault Rifle?

No. The assault rifle is not shiffled into the library, for the same
reason stated above for burned-when-used weapons.

The DBR is not shuffled into the library because their is no provision
for recycling damage modifiers, ammo, strike cards, etc. Horrid
Reality only handles the weapon itself, not what you do with it.
